content.content: The file /work/.tmp/claude-eval-NNaAiY/home/cwd/src/dates.js has been updated successfully.

lines: // Parse an ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) into a UTC Date.

content.text:
Fixed. `npm test` now passes (1 of 1).

The bug was in `parseDate` in `src/dates.js`. It passed the month from the ISO string straight to `Date.UTC`, which counts months from 0. Every parsed date landed one month late, so a Jan 30 invoice was treated as Mar 2 and came out due Mar 16. The fix is `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)`.

`src/report.js` also calls `parseDate`, so its output changes too. It should now be correct as well, but I didn't check it. If any dates from before this fix were saved or sent to customers, they were probably wrong and may need correcting.
